title: Model, Assistant, Agent, Skill
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Four stacked layers, each built on the one below it: a language model, an AI assistant, an AI agent, and an agent skill, with the book's own example for each.

educational.topic: The four layers of AI vocabulary: model, assistant, agent, and skill
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish a language model, an assistant, an agent, and a skill, and say which layer adds tools and a loop.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Does it answer and wait, or act across steps?
commonMisconceptions: A language model looks facts up
An assistant and an agent are the same thing
assessmentOpportunities: Which layer plans, acts, looks at what happened, and acts again?
What does a language model not do?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
